about: The path of every saved stroke, taken on 2026-11-18 from the ink code as it stood before the pen was given its new feel. logs: every ink mark of each fixture log, as InkMark drew it where it was made (drawn) and after its anchor moved it by 40, -30 and scaled it (stretched 2.4 by 0.6, small 0.5, large 3). Each view holds where the drawing sits, its fill, and the SHA-256 of its paths joined by a newline; the marks of the golden fixture and of the sample hold the paths as drawn in full. recorded: every stroke of test/fixtures/strokes.json, drawn as a saved stroke at the pen's own width. Saved ink must draw exactly as it did: this file is never made again from newer code.
